chunks: 4 - He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ’Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, he said: Sa’d ibn ’Abdillāh narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattāb, from Muhammad ibn Sinān, from al-Mufaddal ibn ’Umar al-Ju’fi, from Jābir ibn Yazīd, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ’Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them, he said:

The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, said to ’Ali ibn Abi Tālib, peace be upon him: "O ’Ali, I and you, and your two sons Hasan and Husayn, and nine from the descendants of Husayn are the pillars of the religion and the buttresses of Islam. Whoever follows us will be saved, and whoever turns away from us, their way is to the Fire."

key_terms.أركان الدين: The foundational supports of the Islamic religion, here referring to the Prophet, Imam Ali, Hasan, Husayn, and the nine Imams from Husayn's lineage
key_terms.تسعة من ولد الحسين: The nine Imams descending from Imam Husayn, from Imam Zayn al-Abidin through Imam al-Mahdi, completing the Twelve Imams
key_terms.دعائم الإسلام: The supporting structures of Islam, synonymous with the pillars, emphasizing the essential role of the Ahl al-Bayt in maintaining the religion

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the pillars of faith and who are the twelve Imams?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) addresses Imam Ali (peace be upon him) and declares that he, Ali, their sons Hasan and Husayn, and nine descendants of Husayn are the pillars of the religion and the buttresses of Islam. He states that whoever follows them will be saved and whoever turns away from them will face the Hellfire. This teaching, conveyed through a chain reaching back to Imam al-Husayn via Imam al-Baqir and Imam Zayn al-Abidin, established the doctrine of the Twelve Imams as the divinely appointed leaders of the Muslim community. For early Shia Muslims, this narration affirmed the predetermined succession of the Imams from the Prophet's own household.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn reported to me from his father, who reported from Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abu al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddhal ibn Umar al-Jo’fi, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja’far, Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Husayn, from his father, from his forefather, peace be upon them all, who said:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, told ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him: "O ‘Ali, I and you, and your two sons Hasan and Husayn and nine descendants of Husayn are the pillars of faith and buttress of Islam. Those who will follow us will be saved and those who turn away from us, their way is to hellfire."
